---
title: "Build systems and reproducibility"
---

A workflow system records dependencies so an upstream change rebuilds the right downstream artefacts. It is a safety net against undocumented execution order, not a substitute for reviewing research decisions.

- In R, [`targets`](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/) describes objects and dependencies and rebuilds only what is stale.
- In Python or cross-language work, [Snakemake](https://snakemake.readthedocs.io/) expresses rules, inputs, outputs, and environments.

Make the environment and inputs explicit with a lockfile or manifest, fixed seeds where appropriate, and a release manifest containing provenance and checksums. Alternatives such as Make, Drake, renv, uv, or CI can be appropriate; select one that the team can maintain.
